component.name: Aphrody
component.summary: Unified Sovereign Autonomous Agent Runtime, CLI & Dashboard

description.p: Aphrody is a single high-performance native binary providing polyglot agent orchestration, MCP JSON-RPC protocol server integration, native terminal tools, and Cloudflare R2 / WireGuard mesh connectivity.
Unified binary release with complete MCP suite, Cross-Platform packaging, and GPUI Dashboard integration.
